reports.title: SPS Commerce Reports Strong Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Guidance
section: As a result of the divestiture of the 3P Revenue Recovery business on June 30, 2026, guidance factors in a reduction of approximately $10.5 million in revenue to the second half of 2026. The divestiture is expected to be neutral to Adjusted EBITDA in the second half of 2026.
•Revenue is expected to be in the range of $199.3 million to $201.3 million.
•Net income per diluted share is expected to be in the range of $0.74 to $0.79, with fully diluted weighted average shares outstanding of 36.0 million shares.
•Non-GAAP income per diluted share is expected to be in the range of $1.31 to $1.36.
•Adjusted EBITDA is expected to be in the range of $72.0 million to $74.0 million.
•Non-cash, share-based compensation expense is expected to be $17.0 million, depreciation expense is expected to be $6.1 million, and amortization expense is expected to be $12.3 million.
•Revenue is expected to be in the range of $786.9 million to $788.9 million, representing approximately 5% growth over 2025.
•Net income per diluted share is expected to be in the range of $2.29 to $2.35, with fully diluted weighted average shares outstanding of 36.6 million shares.
•Non-GAAP income per diluted share is expected to be in the range of $5.05 to $5.11.

•Adjusted EBITDA is expected to be in the range of $267.4 million to $269.4 million, reflecting an Adjusted EBITDA margin of 34% at the midpoint, an increase of approximately 330 basis points compared to full year 2025.
